{{Quote|Hey, you! No droids!|COO-2180, to R2-D2|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''COO-2180''' was a [[COO-series cook droid]] who served [[Foodstuff|meals]] to passengers aboard the [[refugee]] [[transport]] ''[[Jendirian Valley]]'' during the [[Republic Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY]], COO-2180 shooed the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] away from its counter when he attempted to collect food for his companions, [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Get outta here!|COO-2180, to R2-D2|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
During the [[Republic Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], the [[COO-series cook droid|cook droid]] COO-2180 operated aboard<ref name="R2 74">{{BuildR2Cite|74|Droid Directory}}</ref> the [[AA-9 Freighter-Liner]] ''[[Jendirian Valley]]'', a [[refugee]] [[transport]],<ref name="Starfighters">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''</ref> serving meager [[Foodstuff|meals]]<ref name="R2 39" /> to the passengers of the [[Starship|vessel]]. COO-2180 was present on the ''Jendirian Valley''<ref name="AOTC" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], including the appearance of COO-2180, to [[22 BBY]].</ref> during which the transport traveled from [[Coruscant]], the [[capital]] [[Planet|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], to the [[planet]] [[Naboo]].<ref name="AOTC" />

During the journey, the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] attempted to acquire food for his companions, [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and her protector, [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], who were traveling discreetly aboard the vessel after a failed [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination attempt]] against Amidala. While serving several plates of [[flatcake]]s, COO-2180 noticed R2-D2 approach the counter,<ref name="AOTC" /> risking the cook [[droid]]'s wrath.<ref name="R2 74" /> The cook [[droid]] objected, insisting that droids were not allowed in line, but R2-D2 collected food regardless. COO-2180 shooed the astromech droid away, simultaneously flipping a plate of flatcakes.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:COO-2180_serving_flatcakes.png|thumb|right|250px|COO-2180 serves flatcakes aboard the ''Jendirian Valley''.]]
A COO-series cook droid,<ref name="R2 39" /> COO-2180<ref name="R2 74" /> was a [[Class three droid|third class]]<ref name="SWTVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' establishes that [[COO-series cook droid]]s, including COO-2180, is a [[Class three droid]].</ref> [[Cooking droid|kitchen droid]], standing nearly seven [[foot|feet]] tall.<ref name="New Droid Cooki" /> COO-2180 had six extendable [[Limb|arms]], on which various tools could be attached, and [[magnet]]ized feet that could lock onto deck plates. The droid had [[Color|brown]] and gray plating, a white [[photoreceptor]] that could see into the infrared spectrum in order to analyze [[Temperature|heat]] distribution while cooking, and an [[olfactory sensor]] to determine if food was spoiled.<ref name="R2 39" />

Like other COO-series droids, its recipe data storage unit was situated in its torso, and its upper pair of arms blocked access to the storage by the cognitive module in its head.<ref name="R2 39" /> As droids were not allowed to queue for food aboard the ''Jendirian Valley'', COO-2180 was bothered by the presence of R2-D2 at the food counter, and the irritable cook droid drove the astromech away.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
COO-2180 first appeared in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], COO-2180 was identified in the [[Droid Directory]] section in [[Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2 74|issue 74]] of the [[De Agostini]] magazine ''[[Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2]]'', published in [[2018]].<ref name="R2 74" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the droid was named in the ''[[Image Attack]]'' feature of [[StarWars.com]] on [[April 22]], [[2003]]. Entirely computer-generated in ''Attack of the Clones'', COO-2180 was originally designed to appear in scenes at [[Dex's Diner]].<ref name="IA">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/04/imageattack20030422.html|series=Image Attack|text=Employees Must Wash Manipulators}}</ref>
